data.title: Senior Director, AI Software Engineering
data.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Point & Click Solutions is seeking a Software Developer to build and maintain healthcare applications used by clinical and administrative teams. You will work across modern [ASP.NET](http://asp.net/) Core applications, established .NET systems, SQL Server databases, and patient-facing web experiences.

**Responsibilities**

- Develop and maintain applications using C#, [ASP.NET](http://asp.net/) Core, Razor, JavaScript, and SQL Server.

- Design APIs, services, background jobs, database procedures, and responsive user interfaces.

- Troubleshoot issues across application, database, integration, and deployment layers.

- Write automated unit and browser-based integration tests.

- Modernize legacy .NET and Windows components while preserving production reliability.

- Build secure integrations using REST, SOAP, SFTP, XML, and healthcare data formats.

- Participate in code reviews, technical design, testing, and release validation.

- Protect sensitive healthcare data through secure coding and authorization practices.

- Collaborate with product, support, QA, and implementation teams to translate operational needs into practical solutions.


**Required Qualifications**

- Professional experience with C# and .NET.
